thread:
evelyn_sdk: Quick heads-up: our JS SDK crashes when imported inside Cloudflare Workers at module init: 'ReferenceError: process is not defined'. Also ran into crypto.subtle differences.

omar_fe: That's because Workers are web-only. Any top-level process.env reads will blow up. Which bundle/entry did you import?

evelyn_sdk: plain import from 'redwood-sdk' in an ESM worker. Miniflare hid it locally (esbuild polyfilled process) but real CF runtime fails.

jia_infra: common trap. Two quick fixes: 1) provide a worker-specific entry (exports['./worker']) that only uses globalThis APIs; 2) avoid process.env at module scope.

evelyn_sdk: I patched locally by injecting a tiny env accessor:
```js
const getEnv = (env, k) => env?.[k] ?? globalThis.__REDWOOD_BINDINGS__?.[k] ?? undefined
```
then pass getEnv into client factory. Works but we need an official approach.

omar_fe: Also check streaming: TextEncoderStream and AbortSignal.timeout are not in some runtimes. Add fallbacks: small encoder wrapper + setTimeout->abort fallback for timeouts.

jia_infra: CI reported missing worker-adapter path: bot-ci logged "ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND './worker'" in node14 matrix. Publishing exports must include explicit subpath mapping and either ship ESM+CJS or document dynamic import for CJS.

evelyn_sdk: Can we ship a tiny 'worker-adapter.mjs' that exports createWorkerClient({fetch, crypto, getSecret}) and an accompanying 'worker-adapter.cjs' shim for old node CI?

omar_fe: Yes, and add an examples/workers/wrangler.js snippet showing how to bind secrets and pass env into createWorkerClient. Also add a short note in onboarding: "Do not expect process.env inside edge runtimes."

jia_infra: I'll open a package/export fix PR and patch CI matrix. evelyn, can you draft the example?

evelyn_sdk: Drafted PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/958. Includes worker-adapter, streaming fallbacks, runtime-safe env getter, and docs for bundlers. Tested on Wrangler preview and works.

bot-ci: CI: redwood-sdk #958 - worker tests passed on node16/18; node14 still failing on legacy export tests.

omar_fe: Great progress. Follow-up: add WebCrypto digest helper in adapter and a short troubleshooting note about local polyfills causing false positives.

evelyn_sdk: Will do. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
